newsitem.title: UK: P&O amends Q4 container data comparisons.
newsitem.headline: P&O amends Q4 container data comparisons.

text.p: British shipping group Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co. on Friday corrected the comparative figures for P&O Containers' fourth quarter and full-year data issued on January 30.

P&O said average revenue per container in the fourth quarter of 1996 totalled 936 stg, down from 1,028 stg a year earlier. The company originally said revenue in the fourth quarter of 1995 was 989 stg.
For the full year 1996, revenue per container totalled 1,010 stg, down from 1,013 stg in 1995. P&O originally said revenue was 1,002 stg in 1995.
The figures for the fourth quarter of 1996 and the full year 1996 were correct as announced.
